b5632cc79070b1d9.description: Job Description Why This Role Matters The Principal Specialist, International R&D Scientist expands Ma’aden’s access to breakthrough technologies, global research networks, and innovation ecosystems that accelerate business growth, sustainability, and operational competitiveness. The role connects Ma’aden with leading universities, research institutes, startups, technology providers, and mining organizations to ensure continuous exposure to emerging opportunities that create long-term value. The role strengthens Ma’aden’s innovation pipeline by identifying, evaluating, and advancing technologies that improve resource recovery, productivity, exploration effectiveness, environmental performance, and processing efficiency. It enables faster conversion of external innovation into practical solutions that support enterprise priorities and future growth. By building strategic international partnerships and guiding technology deployment, the role helps position Ma’aden as a globally connected innovation leader with access to high-impact technologies, research capabilities, and collaborative development opportunities. What You Will Deliver Global Innovation Partnerships Build and sustain strategic relationships with leading international universities, research institutes, mining laboratories, technology providers, startups, and venture ecosystems. Establish collaboration frameworks that accelerate technology development, testing, commercialization, and deployment. Strengthen Maaden’s presence within global innovation networks and strategic technology forums. Technology Scouting & Opportunity Identification Create a robust pipeline of emerging technologies aligned with Ma’aden’s growth, sustainability, and operational priorities. Assess technology maturity, scalability, commercial potential, strategic alignment, and intellectual property considerations. Provide forward-looking intelligence on innovation trends, competitive developments, and technology disruptions. Research & Innovation Delivery Advance development of technologies and solutions that address critical business and operational challenges. Guide experimental programs, pilot studies, demonstrations, and validation activities to confirm business value and operational applicability. Ensure research outputs can be scaled and integrated into operational environments. Technology Evaluation & Deployment Enable effective technical assessments across business units and operational stakeholders. Accelerate progression from concept evaluation to industrial deployment through structured testing and business case development. Improve adoption success by aligning innovation initiatives with operational requirements and implementation readiness. Strategic Collaboration & Ecosystem Management Develop high-value international networks that support co-development, licensing, strategic alliances, and joint ventures. Build productive relationships with government innovation agencies, research programs, industry leaders, and strategic partners. Protect Maaden’s strategic interests throughout partnership development and technology collaboration activities. Portfolio & Value Management Maintain a prioritized innovation portfolio focused on business value, strategic importance, and implementation readiness. Improve visibility of emerging opportunities through technology intelligence, portfolio insights, and executive reporting. Drive measurable outcomes from innovation investments and external technology partnerships. What Success Looks Like Strong international network of strategic innovation partners supporting Ma’aden’s long-term growth agenda. Expanded pipeline of high-value technologies aligned with resource growth, sustainability, and operational excellence objectives. Increased conversion of external innovation opportunities into successful pilots, demonstrations, and operational deployments. Improved visibility of emerging technology trends, competitive developments, and partnership opportunities. Strong technology adoption business cases that deliver measurable operational and commercial value. Enhanced global reputation and influence of Ma’aden within international innovation ecosystems. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mining Engineering, Metallurgy, Mineral Processing, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Geoscience, or a related discipline. PhD is desirable. Experience 10–15 years of experience in mining, mineral processing, technology development, innovation, business development, or strategic partnerships. b56cf7519e9403b5.description: Job description About the job HULL OUTFITTING ENGINEER (PS) We are seeking an experienced Hull Outfitting Engineer (Procurement Support) with 5–10 years of experience in marine and shipbuilding projects. The successful candidate will be responsible for providing engineering support to hull outfitting procurement activities, reviewing technical specifications and vendor documentation, evaluating supplier offers, coordinating with equipment manufacturers, and ensuring that procured hull outfitting materials, components, and systems meet project requirements, technical specifications, and applicable marine standards. JOB RESPONSIBILITIES: Provide engineering and technical support for hull outfitting procurement activities in marine, shipbuilding, and offshore vessel projects. Review project specifications, hull outfitting drawings, material lists, and procurement requirements to identify suitable materials, components, and suppliers. Prepare and review technical requisitions, material specifications, datasheets, and other procurement-related engineering documents for hull outfitting items. Support procurement activities for hull outfitting components, including doors, hatches, ladders, platforms, railings, gratings, access structures, foundations, supports, and other associated items. Review vendor quotations, technical proposals, and compliance statements to ensure compliance with project specifications and technical requirements. Perform technical bid evaluations (TBEs) and prepare technical comparison sheets for hull outfitting materials, equipment, and components. Coordinate with procurement teams, engineering disciplines, suppliers, and manufacturers to clarify technical requirements and resolve procurement-related queries. Review vendor drawings, fabrication details, material specifications, dimensions, weights, and installation requirements for compliance with approved engineering designs. Verify material grades, thicknesses, dimensions, coatings, surface treatments, and other technical requirements against project specifications and applicable standards. Ensure compatibility of procured hull outfitting components with hull structures, vessel arrangements, access requirements, and other outfitting systems. Support the preparation and review of material requisitions, purchase requisitions, and technical documentation required for procurement packages. Review vendor deviations, technical exceptions, and proposed alternative materials or components and coordinate with the engineering team for assessment and approval. Monitor vendor document submissions and coordinate technical reviews to ensure timely approval and compliance with project schedules. Respond to technical queries from suppliers and procurement teams and coordinate with relevant engineering disciplines to resolve discrepancies. Ensure compliance with applicable marine classification society requirements, shipbuilding standards, project specifications, and client requirements. Maintain procurement engineering records, technical bid evaluation documents, vendor data, material specifications, and related documentation in accordance with project procedures. Support material inspection, quality verification, and delivery coordination by ensuring that technical and documentation requirements are fulfilled. Coordinate with hull structure, machinery outfitting, piping, HVAC, electrical, and production teams to address procurement-related technical issues. Support construction and production teams by clarifying material specifications, resolving supply-related discrepancies, and ensuring the suitability of procured components for installation. Ensure procurement engineering deliverables are completed within agreed project schedules and quality requirements. ﻿KEY QUALIFICATIONS: Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Marine Engineering, Naval Architecture, or an equivalent engineering discipline. 5–10 years of relevant experience in hull outfitting engineering, technical procurement support, or material procurement within marine, shipbuilding, shipyard, or offshore vessel projects. Hands-on experience supporting procurement of hull outfitting materials, components, and associated structural outfitting items. Strong experience reviewing technical specifications, material requisitions, vendor quotations, fabrication drawings, and supplier documentation. Experience conducting technical bid evaluations (TBEs), preparing technical comparison sheets, and assessing supplier compliance against project requirements. Good understanding of hull outfitting components, including doors, hatches, ladders, platforms, handrails, gratings, access structures, foundations, and supports. Knowledge of marine materials, material grades, fabrication requirements, corrosion protection, coatings, and installation interfaces. Ability to interpret hull outfitting drawings, fabrication details, material lists, vendor drawings, and technical specifications. Experience coordinating with procurement teams, engineering disciplines, suppliers, and manufacturers to resolve technical queries and discrepancies. Familiarity with marine classification society requirements, applicable shipbuilding standards, and project specifications. Understanding of interfaces with hull structure, machinery outfitting, piping, HVAC, electrical, and other marine engineering disciplines. Experience with marine 3D design software, preferably AVEVA Marine / Hull & Outfitting, or other shipbuilding CAD software, is an advantage. Proficiency in Microsoft Office and experience maintaining procurement documentation, material registers, and vendor data records. Experience in new-build shipbuilding projects, offshore vessels, FPSOs, or similar marine engineering projects is preferred. Exposure to international shipyards, marine EPC contractors, or multidisciplinary engineering environments is preferred. Strong technical evaluation, analytical, documentation, coordination, and communication skills. Ability to work effectively in a project-driven engineering and procurement environment. VERTICAL ENGINEERING Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

b5043e20f7f15ed3.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المسار الحديث للمقاولات عن مهندس إدارة مشاريع للانضمام إلى فريقها في جازان. سيتولى شاغل الوظيفة مسؤولية وضع وتنفيذ خطط المشاريع المتكاملة، وإدارة الجداول الزمنية والتكاليف والموارد، بالإضافة إلى التحكم في التغييرات وتحديد نطاق المشروع بدقة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 2 و 5 سنوات في مجال إدارة المشاريع. المسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع وتنفيذ خطة متكاملة للمشروع، والتحكم في التغييرات، وتحديد نطاق المشروع بدقة من حيث البنود والأزمنة، مع فهم الجوانب الفنية لتنفيذ العمل. تقدير الأوقات والمواعيد النهائية للمشروع، وإعداد الجداول الزمنية باستخدام برامج وتطبيقات تطوير جداول العمل، وتحديد المهام المجدولة وفترات تنفيذها والموارد المتاحة. إدارة التكلفة والموارد المطلوبة لإنجاز المشروع، بما في ذلك تخطيط وإدارة الموارد البشرية والمادية والمعدات والتقنيين، وتقدير التكلفة المتوقعة بالتعاون مع مهندسي التكاليف ومتابعة الإنفاق. إعداد وتطبيق خطة علاقات مع جميع الأطراف ذات الصلة بالمشروع، وتوفير أساس لتوزيع المعلومات ونشر حالة مراحل المشروع. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشاريع الهندسية ونسب تقدمها، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 و 5 سنوات في مجال إدارة المشاريع. إجادة استخدام برنامج Primavera P6. القدرة على إعداد الجداول الزمنية باستخدام البرامج والتطبيقات المتخصصة. مهارات قوية في إدارة التكلفة والموارد. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة جازان. سيعمل مهندس إدارة المشاريع ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة المسار الحديث للمقاولات، حيث يساهم في تنفيذ مشاريع الشركة بكفاءة وفعالية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

b5eb1140644714ff.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مصنع البيوت الأنيقة للأبواب والنوافذ الخشبية عن فني جودة للانضمام إلى فريقه في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى ضمان التزام المنتجات بمعايير الجودة المطلوبة من خلال الفحص والتحليل المستمر. المسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى فني الجودة مجموعة من المهام الأساسية لضمان جودة المنتجات، وتشمل: جمع عينات المنتجات من مراحل التصنيع المختلفة، بما في ذلك المنتجات قيد التصنيع والمنتجات النهائية. إجراء الفحوصات اللازمة لعينات المنتجات والتحقق من مطابقتها لمعايير الجودة المحددة. توثيق نتائج الفحوصات والتحليلات بدقة. تحديد مصادر العيوب المحتملة وتقديم التوصيات للتخفيف من آثارها. تحديث سياسات وإجراءات الجودة بشكل دوري لضمان فعاليتها. متابعة التطورات في اتجاهات القطاع واللوائح الحكومية ذات الصلة بالجودة وتحديث المعرفة الفنية. المؤهلات والخبرة يتطلب هذا الدور مرشحاً يمتلك المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال مراقبة الجودة أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على جمع العينات وفحصها وتحليلها بدقة. معرفة بسياسات وإجراءات الجودة. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مصنع البيوت الأنيقة للأبواب والنوافذ الخشبية. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا كفني جودة، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم.

b5f18796f68b439b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة رائدة الرياض للتجارة والمقاولات عن فني صيانة مبانٍ للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى ضمان تنفيذ خطط الصيانة الدورية والطارئة للمباني بكفاءة، بالإضافة إلى متابعة الأعمال المنجزة وتدقيقها. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة تفاصيل خطة الصيانة الدورية لمختلف الأبنية. إعداد قائمة بالمواد اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال الصيانة الدورية والطارئة. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال الصيانة لضمان الجودة والالتزام بالمواعيد. كيل الأعمال المنجزة وحساب كمياتها وتدقيقها. إعداد المطالبات المالية المتعلقة بأعمال الصيانة. أداء وظيفة مراقبة الوثائق في برنامج إدارة صيانة المباني والتحقق من صحتها. الاحتفاظ بسجلات مشرفي الصيانة والنظافة وأرشفتها بالطرق المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال صيانة المباني. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير خطط الصيانة والوثائق الفنية. مهارات جيدة في إدارة الوثائق والأرشفة. بيئة العمل يعمل فني صيانة المباني بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض، ضمن فريق متخصص يركز على الحفاظ على جودة وكفاءة مرافق الشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة في شركة رائدة الرياض للتجارة والمقاولات.

b513c9bd8b34e0f8.description: About Cigna Healthcare and the Role Cigna Healthcare, a division of The Cigna Group, is dedicated to improving the health and vitality of those it serves. This full-time role for a KSA Underwriting Lead Analyst is based in Riyadh and focuses on enhancing the lives of clients, customers, and patients through robust underwriting practices. The position involves driving growth and improving lives within the Cigna Healthcare framework. Experience-Rated Underwriting Responsibilities Evaluate, modify, and price benefits for large corporate new business and renewal quotations in compliance with underwriting guidelines. Build effective relationships with sales and client management partners to secure and retain business. Identify potential areas for improvement within the Large Corporate underwriting workflow. Collaborate with underwriters in other offices on regional opportunities. Data Governance and Process Improvement Assess, validate, and analyze available datasets for underwriting, with a clear understanding of underlying concepts. Ensure data governance and consistency across underwriting data pipelines and reporting tools. Drive the automation of reporting tools and enhance data models for scalable analysis. Performance Monitoring and Portfolio Management Develop and manage portfolio reporting across key underwriting, portfolio, and financial KPIs. Conduct variance analysis (actual vs. expected, plan delivery, forecasts) and identify key performance drivers. Assess and challenge pricing strategies across business segments and channels. Evaluate the impact of pricing thresholds and decisions on growth, profitability, and market standing. Support and manage pricing frameworks and underwriting guidelines, including periodic review. Business Insights and Stakeholder Collaboration Provide analytical input into annual operating plans, forecasts, and strategic plans. Identify structural performance gaps across segments, channels, and locations, translating data into actionable recommendations. Support cross-functional initiatives with Sales, Strategy & Planning, Actuarial, Finance, and Operations teams. Governance and Control Ensure effective embedded controls to detect inappropriate underwriting practices. Ensure underwriting policies, procedures, and guidelines are implemented, enforced, and periodically reviewed. Maintain underwriting practices in compliance with the latest regulatory requirements and Cigna standards.

b558d2b0e5166205.description: About the Role BAE Systems Saudi Arabia is seeking an Engineering Support System (ESS) Reference Data Senior Specialist to join the Typhoon Support Centre (TSC) in Taif. This full-time role involves managing the Typhoon ESS Reference Data function as part of the TSC Data Integrity Team (DIT) within the ESS Data Management Team, reporting to the Typhoon Weapon System Data Manager. The position requires 5-10 years of experience and offers a competitive salary. Role Purpose and Context The primary purpose of this role is to ensure the timely provision and correct management of Reference Data required by the ESS for the Royal Saudi Air Force (RSAF). This includes ensuring data is embodied efficiently to support aircraft operations and maintenance. BAE Systems Saudi Arabia, as the UK Government’s nominated Prime Contractor, provides equipment, support, and training to Saudi Arabia, maintaining RSAF aircraft and training RSAF and Royal Saudi Naval Force personnel. Key Responsibilities Manage the Data Integrity Team (DIT) within the TSC to ensure timely and correct management of ESS Reference Data. Serve as the focal point for all ESS data changes for both Industry (via Typhoon Technical Support Services) and the RSAF, implementing a stringent data policy. Assess and implement ESS database amendments as authorized by RSAF HQ, including testing Reference and Business data changes before live implementation. Resolve Reference Data queries, define amendments, issue new data, and provide implementation plans for manual or automatic script file changes. Prepare the ESS for newly delivered aircraft and capabilities, testing and checking new reference and business data deliveries on behalf of RSAF HQ. Assess and compare data integrity related to aircraft and component life stored on ESS and Technical Publications systems. Analyze Technical Specialist Reports and data from the In-Service Data Analysis Team to identify trends and determine ESS Data recovery actions. Implement RSAF-approved changes to Industry-provided data that do not conform to RSAF policies or impact aircraft operations/maintenance. Assist in developing and maintaining TSC Processes and Procedures related to ESS Data Integrity. Evaluate ESS functionality from a Reference Data perspective and recommend improvements to RSAF HQ. Provide direct support to the Typhoon Weapon System Data Manager and act as deputy when required. Assist with structured On-the-Job training, coaching, work experience, and mentoring for RSAF and/or Saudi National ESS Reference Data Management staff. Qualifications and Experience Essential: Degree level qualification (or HND/HNC with extensive practical experience and formal workplace training) in Aeronautical, Mechanical, or Electrical engineering. Essential: Significant experience in a design and support engineering organization within an aircraft-related industry. Essential: Proven experience in managing approved data sets. Essential: In-depth knowledge of Aircraft Reference Data and Business Data principles, practices, and their relationship to continuing airworthiness management. Essential: Capability to manage multiple simultaneous programs under tight deadlines with multiple stakeholder inputs. Essential: Ability to manage a multi-skilled, multi-national team and integrate it into a virtual, multi-agency team. Essential: Proficiency in strategic thinking and communication of ideas and solutions across management chains. Essential: Seasoned knowledge of data management presentation techniques. Desirable: Experience with Typhoon or other fast jet platforms. Desirable: Experience in an aircraft military support/maintenance environment at a supervisory level. Desirable: Knowledge of the Typhoon Engineering Support System (ESS). Desirable: Experience with Microsoft Office suite and TeamCenter application as a user. Work Environment and Development This role is based at the Typhoon Support Centre (TSC) in Taif, KSA. BAE Systems Saudi Arabia is committed to supporting the Saudi Arabian National Agenda, including Saudisation and the training and development of Saudi National capability through the growth of Saudi National Partner Companies, reinforcing industrialization and partnerships. Application Information Candidates meeting the specified qualifications and experience are encouraged to apply for this full-time position.

b582bfb0c20c6417.description: About the Role مجموعة الطاير is seeking a Visual Merchandiser to join their team in Riyadh. This is a full-time position suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience. The role involves contributing to the visual presentation of luxury retail experiences. Work within a diverse team to deliver customer-focused retail presentations. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of experience in visual merchandising or a related field. b5f77335d4c9f1a9.company_name: مدارس الحصان النموذجيه الاهليه ورياض الاطفال
b5f77335d4c9f1a9.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مدارس الظهران الأهلية عن معلم مرحلة متوسطة حاسب آلي للانضمام إلى فريقها التعليمي في الظهران، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور على تدريس طلاب المرحلة المتوسطة في مجال الحاسب الآلي، ووضع خطط الدروس، وتقديم الدعم لتنمية الطلاب أكاديميًا وسلوكيًا. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع خطط الدروس بما يتوافق مع المنهج الدراسي والرؤية الأكاديمية للمدرسة، واختيار المصادر التعليمية، وتصميم المواد التعليمية والدروس. تدريس الطلاب في مجال الحاسب الآلي، وتقديم الدروس الفردية والجماعية، وتيسير المناقشات، وتحديد الواجبات، وتنظيم الأنشطة العملية والرحلات التعليمية. إدارة سلوك الطلاب وتفاعلاتهم داخل الفصل الدراسي لضمان بيئة تعليمية فعالة. تحديد أهداف واضحة للتعلم، وإعداد الاختبارات والواجبات وإدارتها، ووضع الدرجات لتقييم التقدم الأكاديمي للطلاب. تقديم المشورة للطلاب وأولياء أمورهم بهدف تحسين الأداء الأكاديمي والسلوك، وتحديد الطلاب الذين يحتاجون إلى اهتمام إضافي وتحديد الطرق المناسبة لتلبية احتياجاتهم. تسجيل الحضور والدرجات وأداء الطلاب بشكل فردي، وإعداد التقارير الدورية المتعلقة بذلك. حضور اجتماعات الموظفين والتنسيق المستمر مع الزملاء المدرسين والمسؤولين ومساعدي المدرسين لضمان التكامل التعليمي. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال التدريس أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تدريس مادة الحاسب الآلي لطلاب المرحلة المتوسطة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في التواصل اللفظي والكتابي. القدرة على إدارة الفصل الدراسي بفعالية. مهارات تنظيمية وتخطيطية قوية. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق تعليمي. بيئة العمل يعمل المعلم ضمن بيئة تعليمية داعمة في مدارس الظهران الأهلية، ويكون جزءًا من فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تحقيق التميز الأكاديمي للطلاب في المنطقة الشرقية. معلومات إضافية هذا الدور بدوام كامل، وسيتم تحديد الراتب بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة بعد المقابلة.

b5d9a17f942aa3e6.description: About the Role Qiddiya Investment Company | شركة قدية الاستثمارية is seeking a Director- Human Resources to join their team in Riyadh, Riyadh Province. This full-time role involves leading the people strategy across multiple hotels within a portfolio, reporting to the Cluster General Manager. The Director will serve as a strategic business partner to hotel leadership and ownership, overseeing all aspects of human capital management for hotels with diverse positioning, operating models, and staffing requirements. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute a cluster-wide Human Resources strategy aligned with business objectives, operating models, ownership priorities, and brand requirements. Lead all Human Resources pre-opening activities, including developing workforce strategies, establishing organizational structures, and building leadership teams. Implement HR systems and policies to ensure the portfolio attracts, develops, and retains talent while complying with local regulations and company standards. Drive a high-performance culture focused on accountability, development, engagement, and service excellence. Lead recruitment strategies, workforce planning, and talent pipeline development across the cluster. Develop and implement Saudization strategies, including recruitment, training, and development programs for Saudi nationals. Establish cluster training and development strategies, including leadership development and succession planning. Lead employee engagement initiatives, culture-building activities, and recognition programs. Establish performance management frameworks and support leaders in performance coaching and talent reviews. Oversee compensation and benefits programs, ensuring competitive and equitable structures. Prepare and manage Human Resources operating budgets and pre-opening budgets, monitoring HR-related expenditures. Act as the primary Human Resources representative for ownership, hotel leadership, and external stakeholders. Qualifications and Experience Over 10 years of proven Human Resources leadership experience within hotels, hospitality portfolios, mixed-use developments, or complex service organizations. Strong pre-opening experience, including workforce planning, recruitment mobilization, HR systems implementation, and opening readiness activities. Experience preparing manpower budgets, staffing structures, and Human Resources Pre-Opening Budgets (POB). Strong understanding of labor laws, employment regulations, Saudization requirements, and workforce compliance in Saudi Arabia. Demonstrated expertise in talent acquisition, employee relations, organizational development, succession planning, compensation, and performance management. Experience establishing organizational structures and staffing models for hotels with varying positioning and operating requirements. Required Skills Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with ownership, operating teams, and government authorities. A collaborative leadership style with a passion for developing talent and building high-performing teams. Strong commercial awareness and the ability to align people strategies with business goals. Excellent communication, coaching, and change management capabilities. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh Province, within a dynamic environment focused on the successful pre-opening, opening, and stabilization of multiple hotel properties.

b51db15f7fb9ad65.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن العلامة المحترفة لحلول الأعمال عن توفر شواغر وظيفية لمقدمي طعام (Waiters) للانضمام إلى إحدى المنشآت في مدينتي جدة والرياض. يبحث عن مرشحين ذوي خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال تقديم الطعام، للعمل بدوام كامل. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تحية الزبائن وتوجيههم إلى طاولاتهم. تقديم قوائم الطعام والمشروبات وشرح الأطباق الخاصة اليومية. أخذ طلبات الزبائن بدقة والتأكد من توصيلها إلى المطبخ بشكل صحيح. تقديم الطعام والمشروبات للزبائن بطريقة احترافية ومهذبة. التأكد من رضا الزبائن عن الخدمة والطعام. تنظيف الطاولات وإعدادها للزبائن التاليين. التعامل مع استفسارات وشكاوى الزبائن بفعالية واحترافية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات كمقدم طعام في بيئة مطاعم أو ضيافة. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق. مهارات تواصل ممتازة ولباقة في التعامل مع الزبائن. القدرة على العمل تحت الضغط وفي أوقات الذروة. الالتزام بمعايير النظافة والسلامة الغذائية. بيئة العمل سيعمل مقدم الطعام ضمن فريق ديناميكي في إحدى المنشآت المرموقة في مدينتي جدة والرياض. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب المرونة في ساعات العمل لتلبية احتياجات العمل. المزايا راتب شهري يتراوح بين 3,750 ريال سعودي و 5,625 ريال سعودي. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المرشحين المؤهلين والمهتمين بهذه الفرصة للتقدم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين الذين تتوافق مؤهلاتهم مع متطلبات الدور.

b544e58ee5940ebb.description: About the Role AECOM is seeking a Lighting and AV Engineer to join our team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves the design, installation, configuration, and maintenance of advanced lighting and audio-visual systems for various corporate events, venues, and facilities. The role requires collaboration with clients, production teams, and vendors to deliver technical experiences that meet project specifications. Company Overview AECOM is a global leader in infrastructure, focused on delivering solutions across water, environment, energy, transportation, and buildings. As a professional services firm, AECOM partners with public and private sector clients to develop sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle, from advisory and planning to design, engineering, and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm. Key Responsibilities Design and implement lighting and AV system solutions based on client specifications and venue requirements. Install, configure, and test lighting fixtures, projectors, screens, audio systems, and associated equipment. Operate and manage lighting consoles, audio mixers, and control systems during events and productions. Troubleshoot technical issues and perform preventive maintenance on all AV and lighting equipment. Collaborate with event planners, production managers, and other stakeholders to ensure technical requirements are met. Coordinate with vendors and equipment suppliers for component sourcing and inventory management. Provide technical support and guidance to clients and team members during setup and execution. Document system configurations, equipment specifications, and maintenance records. Stay current with emerging lighting and AV technologies and industry best practices. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in lighting and audio-visual engineering. Demonstrated ability to design, install, configure, and maintain complex AV systems. Proficiency in operating lighting consoles, audio mixers, and control systems. Experience with CAD and specialized AV design software. Strong understanding of safety regulations, electrical codes, and industry standards. Work Environment This position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and operates in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. The role requires a detail-oriented and innovative approach to technical problem-solving. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply for this full-time opportunity. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

b552b4892521bcd0.description: About the Role Dana Rayhaan by Rotana is seeking an Information Technology Manager to join our team in Dammam. b55cbcf6b8515eca.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سلطان محمد السلطان وشركاؤه للاستشارات المهنية عن أخصائي مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الخبر. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تعزيز فرص النمو التجاري وبناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء، مما يساهم في تحقيق الأهداف البيعية للشركة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية استقطاب عملاء جدد وتوسيع قاعدة العملاء. تطوير الفرص التجارية المحتملة وتحويلها إلى صفقات ناجحة. إعداد ومتابعة العروض البيعية لضمان إتمام الصفقات. بناء علاقات قوية ومستدامة مع العملاء الحاليين والمحتملين. تحقيق المستهدفات البيعية المحددة بشكل دوري. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على استقطاب العملاء وتطوير الفرص التجارية. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل وبناء العلاقات. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الخبر بالمنطقة الشرقية، ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية تركز على تحقيق الأهداف وتطوير المهارات. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

b5af541dfe772996.description: About the Role St. Regis is seeking a Housekeeping Manager (Saudi Only) to oversee daily shift operations in Riyadh. This full-time role is responsible for ensuring guestrooms, public spaces, and employee areas are clean and well-maintained, while also managing Housekeeping, Recreation/Health Club, and Laundry operations, if applicable. The position requires 2-5 years of experience and focuses on maintaining guest and employee satisfaction within budget parameters. Key Responsibilities Manage daily Housekeeping shift operations, ensuring compliance with all policies, standards, and procedures. Inspect guestrooms daily and communicate status to the Front Desk efficiently. Prepare work assignments based on room cleaning lists and prospective check-outs. Maintain inventory to ensure adequate supplies for all operations. Implement and supervise an effective inspection program for all guestrooms and public spaces. Monitor departmental operations to achieve or exceed budgeted financial goals. Ensure employees have proper supplies, equipment, and uniforms, and communicate areas needing attention.
